verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a public REST API with detailed capabilities (CRUD on feedback, features, teams, custom fields, pagination, webhooks) confirmed by a live docs site (llms.txt returns 200), plus a documented MCP server enabling agentic control. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger machine-readable spec (404s on standard paths) and no independent third-party developer corroboration of the API's robustness.
